description: Promoted from open deferral #516 on visualization-mcp-surface-and-help-contract. BenchBox exposes result-aware suggest_charts and generate_chart tools, while the installed textcharts dependency has a separate raw-primitive MCP server. Source alone cannot establish whether a client harness exposes both servers together. Resolve and record the supported boundary with runtime evidence before any bundling or proxying decision; this follow-up must not silently register external textcharts tools.
